frame: one adult shopper stands at a plain shop counter holding a plain jacket on a hanger, side view, whole figure, same distance from the viewer, a bare wall behind. On the counter opposite the jacket lies a pile of blank coins as payment. Only the size of the coin pile changes.
sentence_nl: Die jas is duur, maar deze jas is goedkoop.
sentence_en: That coat is expensive, but this coat is cheap.

frame: one adult man sits on the edge of a plain bed, front view, whole figure, same distance from the viewer, a bedside table with a lamp beside it and a bare wall behind. Only the eyes, brows and posture of the face and body change.
sentence_nl: Deze man is wakker, maar die man is slaperig.
sentence_en: This man is awake, but that man is sleepy.

frame: one adult man stands facing the viewer beside a plain radio with a blank front, no dial marks or numerals, on a table, whole figure, same distance from the viewer, a bare wall behind. Only the sound lines around the radio and the hands change.
sentence_nl: Deze radio is stil, maar die radio is luid.
sentence_en: This radio is silent, but that radio is loud.

frame: one adult man stands facing the viewer, whole figure, same distance from the viewer, a bare wall behind, one plain open box on the ground at his feet. Coins are blank discs with no numerals. Only the coins in the box and the clothes change.
sentence_nl: Deze man is rijk, maar die man is arm.
sentence_en: This man is rich, but that man is poor.

frame: a wide plain square seen from a slight height, same viewpoint, same size, a single bench and a bare building front behind. Only the number of adults standing in the square changes.
sentence_nl: Vandaag is het druk op het plein, maar gisteren was het rustig.
sentence_en: Today the square is busy, but yesterday it was quiet.

frame: one small child and one adult stand on flat grass, side view, whole figures, same distance from the viewer, the adult a few steps behind the child, one deep open hole in the ground just in front of the child. Only one thing changes: a plain fence between the child and the hole, there or not there.
sentence_nl: Hier is het veilig, maar daar is het gevaarlijk.
sentence_en: Here it is safe, but there it is dangerous.

frame: a single plain flowerpot on a windowsill, front view, same size, same plain wall behind. Only the plant in the pot changes, from upright and leafy to bent and bare.
sentence_nl: Dit is een levende plant, maar dat is een dode plant.
sentence_en: This is a living plant, but that is a dead plant.

frame: a row of three plain classroom desks with chairs, front view, same distance from the viewer, a bare wall behind, one adult pupil at each outer desk, no books or writing. Only the middle seat changes: a pupil sits there with a raised hand, or it stands empty.
sentence_nl: Vandaag is de leerling aanwezig, maar gisteren was hij afwezig.
sentence_en: Today the pupil is present, but yesterday he was absent.

frame: one adult stands facing the viewer in a plain shirt, whole figure, same distance from the viewer, a bare wall behind. Only the width of the shirt around the body changes.
sentence_nl: Dit shirt zit wijd, maar dat shirt zit strak.
sentence_en: This shirt is loose, but that shirt is tight.

frame: one adult man stands on a plain park path just after a run, side view, whole figure, same distance from the viewer, a bare tree behind. Only the posture and the face change.
sentence_nl: Deze man is moe, maar die man is nog fit.
sentence_en: This man is tired, but that man is still fit.

frame: one child stands facing a plain big dog on a plain street, side view, whole figures, same distance from the viewer, a bare wall behind. Only the child's posture, brows, eyes and mouth change.
sentence_nl: Gisteren was de jongen bang, maar vandaag is hij dapper.
sentence_en: Yesterday the boy was afraid, but today he is brave.

frame: two children sit side by side at a plain table, seen from the front, upper bodies, same size and place on the page, one plain round cake with no candles on a plate between them and a fork in each child's hand. Only where one straight cut line crosses the cake changes.
sentence_nl: Deze verdeling is eerlijk, maar die verdeling is oneerlijk.
sentence_en: This split is fair, but that split is unfair.
